title: Mystic Heart Guardian
description: A surreal mystical scene featuring an elderly bearded man in purple robes pointing forward, a muscular winged warrior with a red bandana and glowing heart emblem, and a blue horned demon holding an orange orb emerging from a stone archway. The composition is set against a dark background with geometric patterns, alchemical symbols, and vibrant dripping paint effects.
